The FY2024 appropriations he secured flow through HHS’s Newborn Supply Kit program—a Biden-era initiative that spent $300 per kit on items like postpartum pads and nipple cream while failing to address systemic Medicaid fraud.

Real progress isn’t about repackaging globalist handouts—it’s cutting federal strings and letting communities support mothers directly.
